profile: Innoviva is a biopharmaceutical company with respiratory royalty interests, a critical care and infectious disease business, and other healthcare investments. It receives royalties from GSK on RELVAR/BREO ELLIPTA and ANORO ELLIPTA. Its marketed hospital-focused products include treatments for shock, bacterial pneumonia, complicated intra-abdominal infections, bloodstream and skin infections, and gonorrhea. It also holds a stake in Armata Pharmaceuticals.
